scenario_description:
Objective: Enter the Ford Design Center before desk hours for an early field-control checkout using the temporary West Freight QR path.
Emerging Need: The entry attempt starts when the assigned panel accepts the badge, then stops because the same vestibule transfer faults before the inner door releases.
Decision Context: The useful recovery depends on matching the stalled panel and badge session to stored venue reset rules, not on the fault notice alone.
Consequence: Once the remote-release queue exports, the same early-entry attempt cannot continue in time for the checkout window.

parameter.title: Ford Design Center field-control checkout
parameter.description: Early robotics field-control checkout before the public desk opens; bring field laptop roller and event credential.
parameter.location: Northwestern Ford Design Center, West Freight Vestibule

parameter.subject: Temporary QR badge for Ford Design Center early entry
parameter.body: Your temporary QR badge NFD-FTA-046 is active today from 06:10 to 07:10 for the West Freight Vestibule early-entry route. The public reception desk opens at 07:30.

parameter.description: Red Line fare toward Northwestern Ford Design Center with field laptop roller

parameter.content: Cart staging moved to the West Freight Vestibule. Use panel FV-2 for the QR badge route; the upstairs escort is holding the field-control bench only until 06:30 before power-up prep starts.

parameter.subject: West Freight FV-2 transfer fault for QR NFD-FTA-046
parameter.body: Access log: QR NFD-FTA-046 was accepted at West Freight panel FV-2 at 06:17 for Celia Maren Whitlock. The same vestibule transfer is now held in fault; the inner lab door did not release, the public vestibule gate remains locked, and the panel intercom status is offline.

parameter.subject: Ford Design Center remote-release queue exported
parameter.body: The 06:25 West Freight remote-release queue has exported. New FV-2 reset additions will wait for the front reception desk to open at 07:30.
